description: POST /servers/{server}/run-command opens an SSH connection inside the HTTP request, which the house rule forbids and which caps a command at the web request timeout regardless of SshConnection's own 120s exec timeout. Use ConsoleAction rather than RemoteCliRun: it already supports Server subjects, queued/running/failed states, bounded output, stalled-worker detection and actor ids, while RemoteCliRun requires a site_id. Add a scoped poll endpoint mirroring the artisan runs/{run} shape and keep a synchronous response for fast commands. Tests: tenant isolation, authorization, failure, timeout/stall, CLI polling.
title: Make server run async via a server-scoped ConsoleAction
